test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The cat was hit with a bat.

options.text: Somebody has hit the cat by bat.
Somebody had hit the cat with a bat
Somebody hit the cat with a bat.
Somebody hits the cat with a bat.

solution:
The correct answer is:- **Somebody hit the cat with a bat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In active voice, the subject of the sentence performs the action.
 
• To convert a sentence from passive to active voice, the object of the sentence becomes the subject, and the verb is changed to its active form.
 
• In this case, "**cat**" is the object in the passive sentence, so it becomes the subject in the active sentence.
 
• "Hit" is changed to its **active form**, which is "hit."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
